data.title: FRO – Declares special one-time dividend after sale of two VLLCs
data.description: Frontline plc, a leading company in the maritime industry, recently disclosed on August 4, 2026, about the successful sale of two Very Large Crude Carriers (VLCCs). Consequently, the Board of Directors has decided to distribute a special one-time dividend of $0.80 per share to its shareholders. This move aligns with Frontline's fundamental approach of providing monetary returns to its investors. Additionally, this special dividend supplements the regular dividend of $2.61 per share that had been announced for the second quarter of 2026.

data.title: Cellectis to Host Conference Call and Webcast on September 14 to Provide a Business Update
data.description: On September 11, 2026, Cellectis, a biotechnology company (Euronext Growth: ALCLS - NASDAQ: CLLS), shared plans to hold a conference call and webcast on September 14, 2026. Cellectis is known for its innovative gene editing platform used in developing critical cell and gene therapies. The call aims to offer an update on the company's operations and future endeavors.

data.title: AMREP Reports First Quarter Fiscal 2027 Results
data.description: In Havertown, Pennsylvania, on September 11, 2026, AMREP Corporation (NYSE: AXR) announced its financial results for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027. The company disclosed a net income of $276,000, equivalent to $0.05 per diluted share, for the quarter ending on July 31, 2026. This marked a significant decline compared to the same period in the previous year when the net income was $4,692,000, or $0.87 per diluted share. Revenues for the first quarter of 2027 were reported at $6,051,000, contrasting with $17,851,000 in the first quarter of 2026.

data.title: Standard Lithium Announces Change to Board of Directors
data.description: VANCOUVER, British Columbia - On September 11, 2026, Standard Lithium Ltd. disclosed in a statement that Karen Narwold, a member of its Board of Directors, will step down from her position on September 15, 2026. This decision was made due to her acceptance of a new executive role which demands more time commitment. Standard Lithium, a prominent lithium company nearing commercial status, operates with listings on both the TSX Venture Exchange under the symbol SLI and the NYSE American as SLI.

data.title: Arteris Announces New Employment Inducement Grants
data.description: On September 11, 2026, Arteris, Inc. based in Campbell, California, a prominent technology company specializing in accelerating semiconductor development in the AI sector, made public the issuance of equity awards to Saurabh Sinha, the Chief Financial Officer. These inducement awards were a crucial aspect of Mr. Sinha's decision to join the company, falling under the guidelines of the company's 2022 Employment Inducement Incentive Plan and conforming to Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4). Arteris, Inc. is listed on Nasdaq under the ticker symbol AIP.

data.title: Rainier Acquisition Corporation Announces Separation of Its Class A Ordinary Shares and Warrants on Nasdaq, Commencing September 14, 2026
data.description: Class A ordinary shares will be traded on The Nasdaq Capital Market under the symbols RNAQ, with warrants under RNAQW. Units that remain unseparated will continue to trade as RNAQU.

data.title: MaxCyte Reports Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
data.description: MaxCyte, Inc., a prominent cell-engineering company listed on Nasdaq under the symbol MXCT, announced on September 11, 2026, that the Compensation Committee of the Board of Directors awarded 220,000 stock options and a service-based restricted stock unit (RSU) for 110,000 shares of common stock to Sidharth Kapileshwar. Kapileshwar joined as the Senior Vice-President and Chief Corporate Development Officer. The awards were granted on August 31, 2026, under the 2026 Inducement Plan, marking an inducement for Kapileshwar to accept the employment offer in compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4).

data.title: Essex Property Trust to Present at The Bank of America Global Real Estate Conference 2026
data.description: In San Mateo, California, Essex Property Trust, Inc. (NYSE:ESS) shared that Angela L. Kleiman, their President and CEO, will join a roundtable discussion at the 2026 Bank of America Global Real Estate Conference on September 16, 2026, at 10:20 a.m. ET. You can tune in to the panel by accessing the webcast link on the Company’s Investors website, www.essex.com. The webcast recording will be accessible for thirty days following the event.

data.title: American Healthcare REIT to Participate at BofA Securities 2026 Global Real Estate Conference
data.description: American Healthcare REIT, Inc. revealed that its Chairman and CEO, Jeff Hanson, along with President and COO Gabe Willhite, and VP of Investor Relations & Finance Alan Peterson, will partake in a roundtable discussion at the BofA Securities Global Real Estate Conference on September 15, 2026, from 12:45 p.m. to 1:20 p.m. Eastern Time. The conference aims to address key industry topics with a focus on the company's performance and future prospects. This event is anticipated to provide valuable insights to stakeholders and investors.

data.title: Amrize Appoints Mario Gross as President of Building Envelope
data.description: In a recent announcement from Amrize (NYSE: AMRZ), it was reported that Mario Gross has been appointed as the President, Building Envelope, effective from September 11, 2026. Gross will be taking over from Jake Gosa, who is resigning from the position and ensuring a seamless handover process. Gross, previously the Chief Supply Chain Officer, joined Amrize's Executive Committee upon the company's NYSE listing in June 2025. Before that, he held the role of Chief Operating Officer of the Building Envelope division.

data.title: Saudi Arabia faces increased risk for oil exports due to attacks on pipeline & Red Sea shipping, with Houthi militias gaining control.
data.description: Navigating the region was already challenging for ship operators, but the risk has escalated with the increased control of Houthi militias in the Red Sea. This development has spiked concerns for the safety of vessels and their crew members in the area. The heightened presence of Houthi militias has significantly amplified the security threat for ships passing through the Red Sea, with a noticeable increase in the number of incidents reported. Ship operators are urged to exercise extreme caution and implement additional security measures to safeguard their vessels and personnel from potential risks posed by the militia group.

data.title: AMD features AI-centric enhancements at IBC 2026, emphasizing its role in shaping media production with cutting-edge technology.
data.description: At the IBC 2026 event, AMD showcased its advancements in artificial intelligence, adaptive computing, and advanced workflows, solidifying its position as a major player in the future of media production. This move indicates AMD's strategic focus on cutting-edge technologies essential for the evolving media industry. AMD's progressive initiatives are expected to shape the media landscape, with their innovative solutions setting a benchmark for next-generation media production.

data.title: VOIDZ collaborates with Runway AI to craft 95-sec film 'Ends Meat', fusing mixed reality & documentary, redefining storytelling.
data.description: VOIDZ is breaking new ground in storytelling by utilizing Runway AI to merge mixed reality and documentary filmmaking in his recent project, 'Ends Meat.' This innovative approach sparked buzz, with the project garnering over 100,000 views in its first week of release. By seamlessly blending technology and traditional storytelling, VOIDZ is changing the game in the world of filmmaking.
